name: H5N1 bird flu
summary: China reports an H5N1 case in a traveller from Vietnam on 23 Nov; US cases stay animal-linked, no human spread
state: China reported to WHO an H5N1 case in a man from Quang Ninh, Vietnam, who tested positive at a Guangxi border port on 2 Nov; two household contacts tested negative (BNO News, 23 Nov). Washington state reported the first US bird flu death of 2026 on 2 Nov, and Oregon a mild dairy-linked case on 19 Nov (CNN). Searches to 28 Nov found no human cluster or person-to-person spread, so Normal holds.
for_you: Risk to the public remains low. Follow UKHSA and NHS advice: avoid touching sick or dead birds and report them to Defra.

why: H5N1 is the flu strain scientists most fear could become a pandemic; it has spread to mammals and dairy cattle.
drivers: Human cases, mammal-to-mammal spread, mutations, surveillance.
